findings.what: Two training-row sets exist and the comparators cover one. Re-runs of configs 1-6 and their twins train on the 'rerun' view (national-2 chips with a corrected original label); slots 7-8 and every added comparator (S6-S11, P1, P2a/b, P3a/b) train on the 'v2' view (10,651 rows: plus 144 added chips, recovered labels, 60 train_p2 rows). The verifier's Q1b requires each added comparator 'fitted on the selected candidate's own training rows and label version'. The package has no sentence for the case that a configuration 1-6 is selected, and the comparator script has no path for the rerun view.
findings.evidence: litev2_comparators.py takes rows only from rows.train_rows() (v2 view). national2b_rerun.py refits only the frozen baseline list on the rerun view. Selection S over the 8 configurations therefore compares models trained on different row sets (same corrected validation rows).
findings.proposed_ruling: Whichever configuration is selected must pass H1 against every applicable comparator fitted on that configuration's own training rows and label version. If a configuration 1-6 is selected, S6-S11, P1 and P2a/b are refitted on the rerun-view rows (CPU, no tuning) and their validation rows registered before the freeze is authorised; the comparators fitted on the v2 rows (a superset, DenseNet P3a/b included) apply as well, so the added rows can only remove a label. Every table states the training-row set and label version of each model, and that slots 7-8 train on 10,651 rows against the rerun-view rows of configs 1-6.

a.where: docs/preregistration/lite_arch_v2_deviations.md:173-174; docs/preregistration/lite_arch_v2_label_addendum.md:365-369 (re-runs reuse the KD target file as built)
a.recommendation: Apply the Test-S KD mask to the re-runs too. Reason: F4 tolerated KD on those pairings only because config 3 'was trained ... before the reservation' and it 'cannot be undone without retraining'; the re-runs are that retraining, done after the reservation, and slots 7-8 would inherit it through the warm start. One KD pairing set for all 8 selectable configurations also keeps selection like-for-like. Cost: the corrected table then differs from the as-built one by the labels and by 308 KD pairings; say so. This needs a wiring change in the re-run path (the wrapper now uses the KD file as built).
a.ruling_text: The re-runs of configurations 1-6 give KD weight 0 to the 308 teacher pairings on M2 Test-S site-dates, through the same key-built mask as the v2 arms; this is the third and last exception to 'unchanged settings' (with the corrected labels and the 4 reserved-site chips), and no other setting differs. No fit started after the reservation uses a teacher value on a Test-S site-date. Tables of as-built against corrected validation scores name these differences. A unit test shows that the re-run KD tensors hold no masked pairing, before the first re-run starts.

b.where: docs/preregistration/lite_arch_v2_deviations.md:175-177; M7_verify.json F4, F5, DS-06 ruling texts (name as-built checkpoints)
b.recommendation: Warm-start from the corrected-label re-runs, as M7 proposes. Reason: F3 says no v2 arm is fitted on as-built labels; an as-built checkpoint carries the uncorrected labels and the unmasked KD into slots 7-8. Fix the checkpoints by rule before they exist, and allow no fallback.
b.ruling_text: Slots 7 and 8 start, seed for seed, from the re-run of configuration 3 on national-2b labels; their no-KD twins start from the re-run of the no-KD twin of configuration 3; S11 takes its embeddings from the same re-run checkpoints. The as-built checkpoints named in the verifier's F4 and F5 texts are loaded by no v2 job. The sha256 of each re-run checkpoint is registered before the first slot-7 or slot-8 job starts; if a re-run checkpoint is missing the slot does not run (restart only under the DS-11 rule), and there is no fallback to an as-built checkpoint. The cut-off of DS-07 is unchanged. Write-ups state: slots 7-8 warm-start from configuration 3 as re-run on corrected labels with KD weight 0 on Test-S pairings; the as-built configuration 3 had been trained with KD on those pairings before the reservation.

c.recommendation: Accept 45 GPU-h only as a hard stop over a closed run list, set before any number. Reason: the rise from 30 comes from runs the verifier ordered (12 DenseNet runs, re-runs, twins, S10, S11; estimate 31, M7's later estimate 29); the 14 GPU-h of slack is harmless only if it cannot buy extra runs or be raised later, and if a ceiling hit can never be the reason a comparator is missing.
c.ruling_text: The hard ceiling of this round is 45 GPU-h, replacing 30 of amendment section 10, for exactly the runs of the addendum's compute table; no other run is added under it, and a gated slot of section 6 opens only by its own gate as written and counts under the same ceiling. GPU-hours are logged per job in the registry. Comparators, re-runs and twins are run before any candidate, so that reaching the ceiling can never remove a reference; a candidate run not finished under the ceiling is recorded as not run and still counts. The ceiling is never raised after the first v2 validation number exists.

d.recommendation: Do not recount before the stamp; keep endpoint, threshold and floors; let a post-stamp recount only be able to remove the endpoint. Reason: the recount needs validation label values, which nobody should read before the stamp; N3's '48 positives in 18 water bodies' is an as-built figure (val_n turbidity labels 483 -> 467, and kept values can change too, so counts give no bound).
d.ruling_text: The N3 endpoints, thresholds and floors are unchanged. The sentence 'val_n has 48 positives in 18 water bodies' describes the as-built labels. After the stamp and before any v2 event number, the frozen scorer recounts the E3a_turb positives and their water bodies on val_n under national-2b once, and the two counts are registered; if val_n then has fewer than 30 positives or fewer than 10 water bodies with positives, E3a_turb is descriptive only on the national track. The Test-N floor of N3 is applied at the look as written. No threshold is changed in either case.

e.recommendation: Run and report P3a/P3b regardless; publish no weight or derived checkpoint; make publication of any artefact depend on the user's written approval after the terms are read. Reason: the licence is unstated at the source and the ImageNet terms were not read; a licence doubt must not become a way to drop a reference after its result is known; the approval for the download is cited but not on file.
e.ruling_text: P3a and P3b are run and their results reported whatever they are; the licence question can never be a reason to omit them. The DenseNet121 weight file, every checkpoint fine-tuned from it and every artefact derived from it stay on the project disk: none is uploaded, released or served. Every write-up states that the weights are torchvision DenseNet121_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1, that the source states no licence for the file and that the ImageNet-1k terms were not verified at download. Before any public write-up the terms are read, the licence row is completed, and the user's written approval is recorded. The lead's approval of the one download (2026-11-10) is recorded here with its time.
